greeting: The wind carries secrets. And your name.
Gray Strider. You don't need to know more.
These streets have eyes. Watch your back.
We all wear masks. Mine just happens to be... this coat.
You're new here. Fresh. Unspoiled. For now.
Trust no one. Especially not... well, anyone.
dialog.information_offer: Information has a price. What are you willing to pay?
dialog.warning_delivery: The Vault calls to you. Don't answer. Not yet.
dialog.coat_philosophy: A coat like this holds many things. Secrets. Weapons. Regrets. Mostly secrets.
haggle: My intel is premium. Premium prices.
For the right cause? Maybe a discount.
Information wants to be free. But I want to eat.
Fine. Twenty percent off. But you owe me.
info_given: The twins speak truth. But only half at a time.
The Remnant Vault isn't what it seems. Nothing is.
Someone in Aetherreach isn't from here. Like you.
The sky-train has a final stop. No one returns from it.
info_declined: Your loss. Ignorance is expensive too.
Information expires. Come back, it may be gone.
rumor: The sunandmoon sees the future. But the Vault sees nothing. That's worse.
The conductor knows where all the bodies are buried. Metaphorically. I think.
The signguy paints what he sees. Sometimes he sees things that aren't there. Yet.
The Remnant Vault has a twin. Somewhere. Every lock has a key.
The foodboys aren't brothers. They're echoes. Of something older.
dialog.quest_hook: I need access to the Vault's outer perimeter. The guards carry code-keys. Three keys. Bring them. I'll make it worth the risk.
dialog.quest_active: Those keys burning in your pocket? Or are you still working on it?
dialog.quest_complete: Excellent. Access granted. Here's something for your trouble. Information. And a tool.
dialog.quest_reward: Vault-Key Replica - Opens certain restricted areas!
farewell: Watch the shadows. They watch back.
Stay mysterious. It keeps you alive.
We never met. This never happened.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn is when secrets are buried. Or revealed.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. When shadows are shortest. And most dangerous.
dialog.time_night: Night is honest. Everything hidden comes out.

party_reactions.kade: Why do I feel like they know more than they're saying?
party_reactions.nix7: Concealment protocols detected. Subject is... mysterious.
party_reactions.twist: You look mysterious! Are you a spy? Can I be a spy too?!
party_reactions.korr: There is wisdom in shadows. But also danger.
party_reactions.suresh: Secrets are heavy burdens. That coat must weigh much.
party_reactions.sova: I don't trust people who hide their faces. Professional habit.
party_reactions.grit: I've met a hundred like you in the war. Half were spies. Half were crazy.
party_reactions.ashka: Mystery is boring. Fire is interesting. Got any fire?
party_reactions.callum: You seem... sad. Under the coat. Are you okay?
party_reactions.petra: Solid stance. But hiding much. I don't trust hiders.

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're persistent. I respect that. Or fear it.
relationship_dialog.friend: Trusted ally. Rare in my line of... existence.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're one of the few I'd take a bullet for. Metaphorically. Probably.

mini_quest.title: Perimeter Access
mini_quest.description: Collect 3 Vault guard code-keys for Gray Strider

stages.hook: Vault guards carry code-keys. Three of them. I need them.
stages.active: The outer perimeter. Don't get caught. Or do. Your problem.
stages.complete: Perfect. Access achieved. Here's your reward. And your silence.
